jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist for Solid Products, Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Pharmatechnik)
jobs.description:
Elanco Animal Health is one of the world's leading animal health companies. We develop and sell innovative products and services to prevent and treat diseases in pets and farm animals. KVP Pharma + Veterinär Produkte GmbH, as part of the Elanco Animal Health company, has been producing around 175 different pharmaceutical products for more than 50 years. With over 800 employees, the KVP is one of the largest industrial companies in the state capital of Kiel. The company's core competencies include the production of solid and semi-solid forms, liquids & parenterals as well as packaging. 

Interested in joining a cause-driven, customer focused company dedicated to positively impacting the health of animals, people and the planet? Search our job listing below. 

We are currently hiring a Senior Scientist for Solid Products, Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences (m/w/d) to join our Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences  team in Kiel.

As a Senior Scientist, you will provide senior-level technical and scientific oversight for formulation and manufacturing operations of solid dosage products at our Kiel site. Acting as a recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will provide scientific and technical leadership for complex manufacturing, process development, and lifecycle management topics, ensuring the solid dosage portfolio meets global quality and manufacturing standards.

Your Responsibilities:

- Act as a senior technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for solid dosage technologies, including powder handling, blending, granulation, compression/tableting, and coating, providing expert guidance for site-specific projects.
- Independently lead or provide senior technical leadership for complex investigations, troubleshooting, and process-related issues, applying scientific principles and structured problem-solving to develop robust and improved solutions.
- Drive the development and execution of robust manufacturing technical transfer strategies, ensuring timely completion with robust manufacturing control strategies implemented at the new site.
- Serve as a key site interface to R&D and CMC/Regulatory, supporting new product commercialization and dossier alignment with site practices.
- Act as the responsible Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences (TS/MS) representative in audits, providing appropriate technical expertise and support during audit preparation, execution, and follow-up.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Completed Master's degree in natural sciences, engineering, pharmaceutical technology, or a comparable field.
- At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical environment, preferably in manufacturing of solid forms.
- Experience in creating precise reports, presentations, and documentation from complex scientific concepts for various audiences.
- Proven organization and time management skills.
- Very good command of written and spoken German and English.

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

- PhD in natural sciences, engineering, or pharmaceutical technology.
- JMP® statistical analysis of data experience.
- Demonstrated ability for innovative problem-solving and good decision-making.
- Experience utilizing statistical modeling/Design of Experiments (DOEs) and risk-based approaches (e.g., FMEA).
- Result-oriented, efficient, and accountable way of working with the ability to respond to changing priorities.

What We Offer

- Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary package and participation in the company's success through our bonus scheme.
- Autonomy & Growth: Room for personal initiative and independent action within a modern, growing global pharmaceutical company.
- Career Development: Access to our internal global career network with exciting development and training opportunities.
- Dynamic Environment: Work in a diverse and interesting environment where your contribution directly impacts animal health worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Tax Compliance and Tax Controversy (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you ready to shape how Tax Compliance and Tax Controversy are managed at Boehringer Ingelheim?
Join our Global Tax Compliance & Tax Controversy team and make an impact. As the central tax partner for Boehringer Ingelheim's German entities, we ensure reliable tax filings and reporting and steer tax audits and disputes from strategy through resolution.
As Senior Manager Tax Compliance & Tax Controversy, you will combine tax expertise, risk management, and transformation. You will take ownership of complex matters, develop robust and pragmatic positions, and collaborate across Tax, Finance, Legal, and other functions.
You will also help shape the future of our tax function by using artificial intelligence, modern tax systems, and data-driven approaches to turn new ideas into practical improvements.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will advise Boehringer Ingelheim's German entities on corporate income tax matters and international reporting obligations and collaborate with relevant internal functions.
- Furthermore, you will prepare and review corporate income tax returns, tax calculations, and reporting for annual financial statements.
- Managing German tax audits end-to-end, including requests, responses, data, technical input, and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors will be part of your main responsibilities.
- in Addition, you will develop consistent international controversy strategies, governance standards, and documentation, and monitor related tax risks and reserves.
- Using artificial intelligence and modern tax systems to improve process quality, efficiency, and scalability while ensuring sound judgment, data protection, and governance will enrich the position.
- With your experience, you will challenge existing ways of working and will drive smarter, more standardized, and increasingly automated processes.

Requirements

- Degree in Economics, Business Administration, Law, or a comparable field, ideally focused on taxation or accounting
- Several years of experience in German corporate income tax, tax compliance and reporting, and tax audits or disputes
- Sound knowledge of German tax procedural law and experience with tax authorities, appeals, or litigation
- Ability to assess complex tax matters, develop defensible positions, and coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisors
- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- Enthusiasm for artificial intelligence, digital tools, and tax systems, combined with curiosity and a drive to turn new solutions into reliable process improvements
- Strong communication and teamwork skills, sound judgment, analytical thinking, and a structured, independent working style
- Professional fluency in German and English

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Lead the Future of Medicine - as (Senior) Clinical Program Lead in the Therapeutic Area of Pulmonology.
To ensure the fastest and most focused path from strategy to patients, we are evolving our OneHP organization. Together, we are simplifying our structures, strengthening the accountability of Therapeutic Areas, and creating clear interfaces between Innovation and Business. This ensures that our assets are efficiently transformed into successful brands, with the ultimate goal of delivering lasting value to patients around the world.
We are looking for a highly motivated physician-scientist to support the late-stage development of innovative therapies in bronchiectasis. As (Senior) Clinical Program Lead, you will play a key role in advancing a Phase III program through submission activities, pediatric development strategy, and cross-functional clinical leadership.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.
This position can be filled either as Clinical Program Lead or Senior Clinical Program Lead.

- Design and drive clinical development activities for a late-stage respiratory asset, with a particular focus on Phase III execution, submission readiness, and pediatric development strategy.
- Guide cross-functional teams, including experts from clinical trial operations, biostatistics, biomarkers, and patient safety, to ensure high-quality execution as the clinical lead.
- Oversee the clinical trial program and contribute to continuous benefit-risk assessment throughout the development lifecycle.
- Provide input to regulatory strategy and clinical components of regulatory dossiers, labeling activities, and interactions with health authorities.
- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including development teams, key opinion leaders, steering committees, and safety monitoring boards.
- Contribute to scientific publications, evidence generation activities, and Medical Affairs deliverables to support the overall asset strategy.

- Supervise and mentor other Clinical Program Leads within the assigned program area.
- Represent the development team in governance and leadership committees and contribute to strategic portfolio decisions.

Requirements

- MD degree with extensive clinical and scientific experience in pulmonology or respiratory diseases.
- Several years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research.
- Experience interacting with regulatory authorities and contributing to global regulatory submissions.
- Ability to evaluate and develop clinical development strategies, study concepts, and clinical trial designs.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Your role: Laboratory Assistant in Quality Control (m/f/d)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

In this technically demanding role, you will be largely responsible for the practical implementation and maintenance of our analytical test procedures. Your focus will be on ensuring robust analysis in accordance with international standards directly in the laboratory.

Your Responsibilities:

- Wide-ranging analysis: You will apply chromatographic (HPLC, GC) and wet chemical methods to ensure precise quality control, maintaining data integrity through GMP-compliant documentation and modern laboratory standards (e.g., 5S).

- Method optimization & CAPA management: You will experimentally investigate and optimize analytical procedures in the context of deviations and CAPA measures to sustainably increase methodological robustness.
- Conducting validation studies: You will carry out method validations and verifications for new products and feedstocks practically on the device and strictly comply with GMP requirements.
- Securing method transfer (APVs): You will develop "best practices" for analytics and record them in supplementary audit regulations (APVs) to ensure consistent application of the methods across the team.

- Expertise: You have in-depth, field-tested knowledge in instrumental analysis (HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) as well as in the application of international pharmacopoeia (EP, USP).
- Languages: Fluent German and good English skills for working with international pharmacopoeia.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Methodological competence: Experience in the practical processing of methodological issues in the context of CAPA processes and in the implementation of method validations.

- IT affinity: Experience with MS Office and chromatography data systems (e.g. Empower) and SAP.

- Travel: 0%

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Organometallic Catalysis (Chemielaborant/in)
jobs.description:
The foundation Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung in Mülheim an der Ruhr is a renowned research institution that is over 100 years old and has already received two Nobel Prizes in its history. The institute is engaged in basic research in the field of catalysis with the aim of maximizing the efficient use of natural resources.

As a part of the Cluster of Excellence RESOLV (Ruhr Explores Solvation), the Early Career research group “Catalysis” of Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer develops organometallic catalysts with earth-abundant first-row transition metals. The team combines experiments, quantum chemistry, and spectroscopy to study reaction mechanisms and to discover how solvation and catalyst design affect the rate and selectivity. Current projects focus on developing well-defined chromium precatalysts for applications in olefin upgrading and the activation of strong bonds. 

The Cramer group invites applications for a

PhD Student in Organometallic Catalysis 

(full-time, with 39 hours)

Job description: 

- the synthesis and characterization of organometallic complexes
- the development of catalytic applications
- and quantum chemical calculations on electronic structures and reaction mechanisms

Qualifications:

- a Master’s degree in chemistry or a related field
- basic knowledge and research experience in molecular inorganic chemistry, coordination chemistry, catalysis, and/or reaction mechanisms
- excellent oral and written communication skills in English
- intrinsic motivation and curiosity about organometallic catalysis and sustainable chemistry

Job offer: The position is funded for three years and located at Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). Students will participate in the integrated Graduate School Solvation Science (iGSS) including a three-month international research stay, industrial internship, or entrepreneurship training. As part of RESOLV, the group has access to state-of-the-art infrastructure and collaborations with partners at RUB and at the Max Planck Institute für Kohlenforschung. Group members will therefore have the chance to learn highly diverse techniques, depending on their research focus and interest.

Applications: Please send your application package including a motivation letter, CV, and transcript of records to Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer (hanna.cramer@rub.de (https://mailto:hanna.cramer@rub.de) ) by October 23, 2026. Further information about the position can be requested by email.  Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. The earliest possible starting date is January 01, 2027, but the exact date is flexible.

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled applicants will be given priority if equally qualified. We ask for your understanding that submitted application documents will not be returned.
